prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 2×1 grid. Redraw cells 1 and 2 (the transparent areas). Keep everything else exactly as it is, and keep image 1's colours and style.

The fault in both cells: the details were drawn about four times their true size — air conditioner units about 4 m long, as big as a car; vent boxes about 3 m; a skylight about 10 m — so each large roof had a few huge details. These are big roofs, 31 × 47 m and 62 × 48 m, seen from high above: draw many small details at true size instead. An air conditioner unit is about 1 m (12 px here), a ventilation stack about 0.6 m (7 px), a roof exit box about 2.5 × 3 m (30 × 35 px), a skylight about 1.5 m (17 px). Scatter 10–20 of them over each roof, with bitumen seams and patches between.

Keep each roof filling its outline exactly as before, a parapet about 0.4 m along all four edges, straight square edges, top-down with no perspective, the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside. No text.

1. 31.2 × 47.2 m (1.5× deeper than wide) — Soviet-era school or college wing, flat bitumen roof with a parapet, roof exits and ventilation stacks, standing narrow end to the street with the entrance on that short front wall
2. 62.4 × 48 m (1.3× wider than deep) — Soviet-era school or college wing, flat bitumen roof with a parapet, roof exits and ventilation stacks
